items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, including 225 errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The productivity pilot's 70 versus 44 shipped-output count is operational activity, not financial or causal lift. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; retain all growth opportunities as deferred backlog.

CFO handoff: continue only the existing repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement, attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, AI usage, or pilot output as financial return. Do not create duplicate telemetry or finance work because the authoritative snapshot already contains the relevant evidence and the existing reconciliation work item.
